general_faqs.answer: You must be 18 years or older to register and place bets. By using the platform, you confirm that you meet the legal age requirement.

general_faqs.question: Can I place bets using my mobile phone?

general_faqs.question: Can I have more than one account?
general_faqs.answer: No. Multiple accounts are prohibited and may result in account suspension.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: What bonuses and promotions are available?
How do I qualify for the welcome bonus?
Is the bonus money withdrawable?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: Bonus funds are not immediately withdrawable until wagering requirements are completed.

answer.definition: A wagering requirement specifies the amount that must be bet before bonus winnings can be withdrawn.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: Can I withdraw my bonus without placing bets?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: No. Bonuses cannot be withdrawn without meeting wagering requirements.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: Do bonuses have an expiry date?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: Yes. Unused bonuses and free bets expire after the stated validity period.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: Are there minimum odds for bonus wagering?
Can I use bonus funds on live betting?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: This depends on the promotion terms. Some promotions allow live betting while others only allow pre-match betting.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: Can I combine bonus bets in accumulator bets?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: Yes, unless otherwise stated in the promotion terms.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: What happens if I withdraw my deposit before wagering the bonus?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: The bonus and associated winnings may be forfeited.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: Are bonuses available to existing customers?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: Yes. Existing customers may receive reload bonuses, cashback offers, and loyalty rewards.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: Can I claim the same bonus more than once?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: No. Bonuses are generally limited to one per user, household, IP address, or device.

bonus_and_promotions_faqs.question: What happens if I violate bonus terms?
How will I know when new promotions are available?
Can the platform change or cancel promotions?
bonus_and_promotions_faqs.answer: Yes. Promotions may be modified, suspended, or canceled at any time in accordance with platform terms and Nigerian regulations.
